name: Magic
tagline: Turns any SVG into a flickering dot grid
description: A one-page tool from the 0xBalance team: drop in an SVG and it resamples the shape into a grid of dots that flicker and drift. Reads like a shader effect but runs on plain canvas, useful for hero backgrounds that need texture without pulling in WebGL.

best.title: Magic
best.note: Upload an SVG, tune grid density and flicker speed, export.
